title: `setManagementFeeBps()` fails to update fee state
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium    **Likelihood:** Medium    ## Description  The `setManagementFeeBps()` function in the `HyperEvmVault` contract allows the owner to update the management fee rate. However, it does not update the fee state (e.g., `lastFeeCollectionTimestamp`) when the fee rate is changed.
